description: This Java class 'CommandConstants' defines constant string values and utility methods related to command and control API endpoints used in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes endpoint names, request/response parts, topic positions, and methods to identify specific endpoint types.

classes.name: CommandConstants
classes.description: Utility class providing constant string values and methods related to command endpoint identification in the Eclipse Hono API.

methods.name: isCommandEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the provided endpoint string matches any of the command endpoint identifiers.

methods.name: isNorthboundCommandResponseEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the provided endpoint string is recognized as a northbound command response endpoint.

methods.name: isNorthboundCommandLegacyEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the provided endpoint string is the northbound command legacy endpoint.
